# Books free-reading mark screenshots

These screenshots compare the oversized free-reading SVG reported on the Books page with the corrected fixed-size mark.

- `before.png`: the reported desktop layout with the SVG expanding inside the flex row.
- `after-desktop.png`: the live Books page at a 1440 × 1000 viewport.
- `after-mobile.png`: the live Books page at a 390 × 844 viewport.

The after screenshots were captured from `https://test.oneuptime.com/books` after rejecting optional cookies.
